title: PMB Chatbot - RAG-Based Admission Assistant (Skripsi Project)
description: A web-based admission assistant designed to help prospective students access information about the university's admission process. It uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide relevant answers based on a managed knowledge base. The system combines a Laravel application with a Python-based AI service.

title: 25Labstudio - Studio Rental Management System (Kerja Praktik Project)
description: A web-based management system for a music studio rental and music course business. It provides booking management, scheduling, and payment processing through Midtrans, helping streamline daily studio operations. and log in/register using a Google account to enhance the user experience.

title: IoT-Based School Miniature and Attendance System
description: A group project involving the development of a miniature smart school environment using ESP32. My contributions included IoT coding, hardware assembly, and the web-based RFID attendance interface. The system also features entry and exit alerts using a buzzer, lighting control, and gas detection using an MQ-series sensor. The ESP32 source code is private and is not included in the repository.
